name: pptx
description: PowerPoint decks (.pptx, .pptm, .ppsx, .potx): every slide rendered in place — text, shapes, images, tables, charts — with zoom and fit.

suggestions.label: Tighten the wording
suggestions.prompt: Tighten the wording on every slide: shorter titles, fewer words per bullet, the same meaning. Keep the layout and design.

suggestions.label: Add speaker notes
suggestions.prompt: Write speaker notes for each slide that has none: two to four sentences on what to say.

suggestions.label: Make it consistent
suggestions.prompt: Check the deck for inconsistent fonts, sizes, colours, alignment and capitalisation, and fix them.

suggestions.label: Summarize the deck
suggestions.prompt: Summarize this deck in five bullet points. Do not change the file.
